doc: Oversized injected memory must NEVER truncate silently (Codex #13386 32KB AGENTS.md, #48679 middle-cut 2500-token summary): an oversized project tier, an over-cap 20k terminal note, and a render-cap-hit platform all leave visible receipts — budget prune markers, a (truncated) note marker, and a capped render — with the injected block still under PI_MEMORY_TOTAL_CHARS.
